author: Sp4rrkii
body:
Hi there, its Skiizii here again, and i would like to apply for moderator on Avicus, so here is the application for it.

Language: I am fluent english
Age:12
Timezone: GMT (Uk time)
Do you have access to TeamSpeak? No
Do you have access to Skype? No
Do you have access to a recording software? No 

( I may not have any of the above but i could probably get a recording software with guidance/recommendation on which ones to get. Also, i do have Discord.)

CRITERIA 1:
I do not yet have any current experience as staff on any servers.

My biggest weakness... I took a lot of time to think about this, and pretty much could not find one. Apart from the fact i dont have access to a mic/ i need to sort my PC and refit a new sound card so i can listen to peeps on TS, not much came to mind.

My strengths - Keeping calm (usually) being active and I have a knick of typing fairly quick.

How do you believe you can help improve the Staff Team?
By being active and taking in reports seriously.  

What qualities does a leader need to have in your opinion? Do you consider yourself to be a leader? Why?
Making final decisions and decide accordingly, taking in everyone else's thoughts and feelings on the current matter at hand is very important in my opinion. I believe i have a Leader spirit mainly because in real life I like taking care of things instead of sitting back and waiting for someone else to do it lazily, especially when something matters to me. 

What attributes distinguish yourself from other players that qualify you to be a moderator?
Being able to take control of things and calmly react quickly, but cleanly is an attribute i think is needed if working as moderator for E.G - If people are being rude in chat, make them stop, dont allow them to just blackmail you or the other person without even getting punished, that is what mods are for right?

What skills do you believe you should have when interacting with the community? Do you believe you have these skills? 
A skill you may need is being able to adapt to the situation, but also, remembering who you are, a moderator, which means you cannot join in with the stupidity of some people in chat. If you do decide to join in, people will lose faith in you and your job, and is how you would probably get demoted. I do think i have the ability to act right as a staff member in these situations


How much time can you commit to being a staff member
I can commit to about 3+ hours a day in a week, although i will be moving into highschool this August, so i will have to see how much time i am allowed on Avicus

CRITERIA 2: 

You are currently undergoing your junior moderator trial. A ban evader is online and he is constantly ban evading and hacking. You are the only one online and the only one who is able to be online. What would you do?
Provide evidence - Via recording as well as delaying them as long as possible by perhaps freezing or any other way to stop a Hacker from making the game bad for players

Another staff member is constantly joining and harassing other people on Teamspeak in their team channel. The staff member is also referee and has physical permissions to be in that channel. However the leaders do not want this staff member in there and they have asked him to leave multiple times. What would you do?
If he is supposed to be there, inform the leaders to refrain from asking him to leave, but if you do know why he is there, let them know why, also, ask him why he is there and what would make the leaders not want him on. However this may not be the case, so I would inform SR staff. Although In the worst case scenario, there is no SR staff online , so i provide evidence to show them later when they are online and maybe they can demote him or strap his perms.



A player appeals a punishment you gave them. You realise that the evidence file is corrupted and therefore there is no physical evidence. You know however this person did indeed break the rules, what would you do?
If I know for sure they have broken the rules then I keep them banned, but let the Senior staff know, and hopefully i would have posted it on YT so there would still be evidence

You are in an Avicus team. One of your teammates is also an Avicus Staff member. One day in your team discord the team member/staff member posts a screenshot of a thread that only staff members can see. The content in the screenshot isn’t very important/confidential but only staff members could see it on the forums. If anything, what would you do?
Pull the forum If I felt uncomfortable with it but ask others aswell to see what they thought about it.


One day the Senior Staff team makes a decision you do not agree with. You do not know all the details of the decision or the circumstances in which they were made and you were simply told by another staff member. However you do not like the decision based from what you know. What would you do?
If it really matters to you tell the Seniors what you dont like about it and why, then ask if anything can change, but if you know basically nothing about it then sometimes you will just have to get on with it.

CRITERIA 3: 

What would getting moderator on Avicus mean to you?
 It would mean alot, being able to shut down hackers and deal with people harassing others is what i love doing 


How passionate are you about Avicus? What does Avicus mean to you?
Avicus is one of my favourite servers to be on and i would itch to be on it everyday, I love the community and so I guess it does mean a lot to me


Do you speak any other languages than English? No


Do you have anything else to add to your application? Nothing apart form I just hope you guys take this application seriously because i have been wanting to be a moderator for a while now, but anyways thanks for your time.

-Skiizii
